title: The Maharashtra Godawari Marathwada Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1998
full_text: The Maharashtra Godawari Marathwada Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1998 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 199823 Act Number: 23 Enactment Date: 1998-08-17 Act Year: 1998 Short Title: The Maharashtra Godawari Marathwada Irrigation Development Corporation Act, 1998 Long Title: An Act to make special provisions for promotion and operation of irrigation projects, command area development and schemes for generation of hydro-electric energy to harness the water of Godawari River pertaining to the State of Maharashtra and other allied and incidental activities including flood control in the Godavari River Valley by establishing the Godawari Marathwada Irrigation Development Corporation. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Water Resources Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra Schedule 1.
